effect_zh: 关闭后 .def 文件不再做实时语法检查，错误行红色波浪线与问题面板条目全部消失
effect_en: With it off, .def files are no longer checked live: red squiggles and Problems panel entries disappear

effect_zh: 开启后同一 .def 中重复声明的属性/方法被标 Warning（重复定义）
effect_en: When on, a property/method declared twice in the same .def is flagged as a duplicate-definition Warning

effect_zh: 悬停 <Flags>/<Type> 等 .def 标签时弹出标签含义说明卡片
effect_en: Hovering a .def tag such as <Flags>/<Type> pops a card explaining what the tag means

effect_zh: 悬停 BASE_AND_CLIENT 等枚举取值时弹出该值的适用范围说明
effect_en: Hovering a value like BASE_AND_CLIENT pops a card explaining where that flag propagates

effect_zh: 悬停 def 方法名时显示脚本实现位置（Implemented-By 反链，文件:行）
effect_en: Hovering a def method shows where the script implements it (Implemented-By backlink, file:line)

effect_zh: Python 实体脚本中 def 声明方法的实现行上方出现 RPC 标记 CodeLens
effect_en: An RPC marker CodeLens appears above the implementing method of a def-declared RPC in entity scripts

effect_zh: types.xml 类型声明行上方出现落库镜链 CodeLens（引用反扫）
effect_en: A storage-mirror CodeLens (reference back-scan) appears above type declarations in types.xml

effect_zh: Python 脚本 self.<属性> 访问处内联显示 def 声明的 types.xml 数据类型
effect_en: Inline `: <type>` hints at self.<property> accesses, from the def/types.xml declaration

effect_zh: Entity 脚本区块内 def 定义的未标注形参后内联显示 def 声明的参数类型
effect_en: Unannotated parameters of methods declared in def script sections get inline type hints

effect_zh: 关闭时状态栏热更项为「未开启: kbengine.hotReload.enabled=false」（watch-off）；开启并给出 globs 后进入就绪态（保存 .py 即发默认热更请求）
effect_en: Off, the hot-reload status-bar item reads 未开启: kbengine.hotReload.enabled=false (watch-off); on (with globs set) it goes ready — saving a .py fires the default hot-reload request
demo: 状态栏热更项 off/on 两态

effect_zh: Show Call Chain 面板以 mermaid 关系图（graph）或纯文本（text）打开
effect_en: The Show Call Chain panel opens as a mermaid graph (graph) or as plain text (text)

effect_zh: 关闭时面板内结果流/查询报「请启用 kbengine.runtimeQuery.enabled」；开启后查询可用（面板本身始终可打开）
effect_en: Off, in-panel queries/streaming error with "enable kbengine.runtimeQuery.enabled"; on, queries work (the panel itself always opens)
visibility: panel query results (需在面板内点 Query)
demo: 需面板内交互触发查询

name_zh: 自动打开最终配置视图
effect_zh: 开启后打开引擎默认配置文件会尝试自动并排打开最终配置视图（需可运行的引擎 bin 以完成最终配置计算；纯工作区无引擎时自动打开不触发）
effect_en: On, opening the engine defaults file tries to auto-open the final-config view beside it (needs a runnable engine bin for the final-config computation; without an engine the auto-open does not trigger)
demo: 需起真引擎或可计算的引擎 bin

effect_zh: 悬停自定义属性名/方法名时显示摘要信息
effect_en: Hovering a custom property/method name shows its summary

effect_zh: 悬停 types.xml 自定义类型时显示落库表/列/类型存储信息
effect_en: Hovering a custom type in types.xml shows its storage table/column/type info

effect_zh: 悬停事件常量时显示注册与监听统计（事件回调反链）
effect_en: Hovering an event constant shows registration/listener stats

effect_zh: 悬停 kbengine.xml 服务配置项时显示取值与说明
effect_en: Hovering a kbengine.xml entry shows its resolved value and docs

effect_zh: 悬停 .sh/.bat 启动脚本里的 KBEngine 启动参数与环境变量时显示说明
effect_en: Hovering KBEngine startup args/env vars in .sh/.bat scripts shows their docs

effect_zh: 悬停局部变量时按函数返回注解推导类型
effect_en: Hovering a local variable infers its type from function annotations

effect_zh: 悬停实体类名时显示 entities.xml 注册信息（Utype/清单位置）
effect_en: Hovering an entity class shows its entities.xml registration (Utype/index position)

effect_zh: 悬停 def 属性/方法时显示声明链（文件与区块来源）
effect_en: Hovering a def property/method shows its declaration chain (file and section origin)

effect_zh: Python 脚本事件回调函数上方显示事件回调/监听数标记
effect_en: An event-callback marker appears above event handler functions in Python scripts
demo: 需注册事件的回调演示文件

effect_zh: Python 脚本 self.<属性> 访问处上方显示属性标记 CodeLens
effect_en: A property marker CodeLens appears above self.<property> accesses

name_zh: 内建属性类型内联提示
effect_zh: self.<内建属性>（如 self.id）访问处内联显示 : <type>
effect_en: Inline `: <type>` hints after self.<builtin property> accesses such as self.id

effect_zh: 重复定义、标签位置、缺失字段等结构问题被标 Warning/Error
effect_en: Structural issues (duplicates, misplaced tags, missing fields) are flagged

effect_zh: 引擎配置文件变更后最终配置视图自动重算刷新
effect_en: The final-config view recomputes itself when the engine config files change

effect_zh: 实体生成向导是否同时产出 Python 实体文件
effect_en: Whether the entity generation wizard also writes the Python entity file

effect_zh: 生成后是否在 entities.xml 自动注册实体条目
effect_en: Whether generated entities are auto-registered in entities.xml

effect_zh: 一键生成实现骨架时方法体为 pass 或 raise NotImplementedError
effect_en: Generated implementation skeletons get a pass body or raise NotImplementedError
demo: 需驱动一键生成实现命令

effect_zh: 方法入口上方显示 Call Chain 提示；关闭后 Show Call Chain 也不生成预览
effect_en: A Call Chain hint shows at method entries; off also disables Show Call Chain previews

effect_zh: 激活时把 **/.kbengine/debug.json 关联为 jsonc 写入工作区设置
effect_en: On activation writes a files.association mapping debug.json to jsonc into workspace settings
demo: 效果落在 .vscode/settings.json 文本差异，非界面

effect_zh: 自动把 KBEngine scripts 根写入 python.analysis.extraPaths
effect_en: Writes the KBEngine scripts root into python.analysis.extraPaths
demo: 效果落在 .vscode/settings.json 文本差异，非界面

effect_zh: 日志面板页面 console 与未捕获异常写入日志面板（内部行为）
effect_en: Webview console errors are captured into the log panel (internal behavior)
visibility: log panel entries (仅出错时可见)

effect_zh: 开启后一键热更流程会走「临时修改→reloadScript→自动还原」路径（默认关，防误触）
effect_en: On, the one-shot hot-reload flow takes the temp-edit → reloadScript → auto-restore path (default off, accident guard)
visibility: reload flow behavior (需驱动热更流程)

effect_zh: 开启时启动调试会话会把 debugpy 注入目标进程并上调试状态板；关闭则不注入
effect_en: On, a debug session injects debugpy into the target process and reports on the debug status board; off, no injection

effect_zh: 开启后调试启动自动寻找/拉起 debugpy 监听并等待接入（默认关）
effect_en: On, debug startup auto-discovers/launches a debugpy listener and waits for attachment (default off)

effect_zh: 导出的 .pyi 存根由生成器产出（generated）或直接引用真实源码（real-source），差异在存根文件内容
effect_en: Exported .pyi stubs come from the generator (generated) or reference real source (real-source); the diff lands in stub file content
demo: 效果在 .pyi 文件内容，非界面
